tldr in its current state this game is like shadow of its potential i advise you to wait before buying it today i finished the game i had quite lot of fun theres denying that however it also left sour taste in my mouth i felt like this could have been so much better it might have been lot more satisfying if only cdpr spent more time developing it the main thing i look for in games is how the story plays out cyberpunk 2077s story would be downright amazing had this been game from the cod franchise or movie yet for cdpr game apart from the ending and few isolated cases the story felt bit linear dont get wrong it still yanks your attention glues you to your seat and makes you want to play just one more hour just to see whats going to happen next as keanu reeves really breathes life into johnny silverhand and the game makes you really connect with most of the characters on an emotional level however i felt like i as the player didnt have much say in which way the story was going to go im not talking about world changing impacts where everything goes upside down in moment im talking about seeing those minor implications the subtle changes we cause with our choices throughout the storythat being said almost all of the side quests were original mini stories of their own and i really enjoyed what they offered the only downside might be that there werent many of them however since most of them were quite creative and intriguing we could say quality over quantity and make peace with that factnpcs acting dumb and disappearing into oblivion the police system lack of activities in the city crashes performance issues visual bugs and even game braking bugs the missing rpg elements like getting haircuts changing our makeup or the inability to make fashion choices without worrying about our build limits of character creation like the body type sliders these are the main things i believe that are really hurting the game the issues with the story i mentioned might be personal thing for but these will be felt by everyone playing the game they are going to break your immersion take away the excitement and prevent you from fully enjoying the game without improving these elements night city feels like glorified lobby where people drive around and enjoy the views while they search for game aka questsall in all we were promised an open world rpg game with shooter elements that was going to immerse us in futuristic world it was promised that the night city would have life of its own and we would be part of that as the player at its current state i cant say these promises were fully kept and are there for you to experiencewhat makes hopeful is that most of the negativity surrounding the game stems from technical issues and number of missing minor features which can be fixed given enough time if cdpr keeps working on the game and manages to implement the necessary improvements ill update my review to recommended

roomates laptop in 2012 i kept keen eye on the game watching it conceptually build and grow over the course of about 9 years my thoughts of the story wandered from the first trailer will we be playing as members of the psycho squad making moral decisions on being dirty or clean cop evolved in the second trailer so we have multiple avenues we are either from the gritty streets or glossy highrises and finally burst with the final trailer its keanu reeves on december 9th all of that build up all of that hope in company i could swear fealty to was completely misplaced while there are some cool moments in this game that kept the light from dying immediately i can not in good faith suggest to anyone that they buy this game what feels wrong about the game the reasons you just shouldnt touch itreason 1 core development issues the game as it stands is messed up on development level that feels like it may never quite recover from patch 11 clearly shown that fixing one problem is only going to bring up slew of more problems two examples being the takemura phone call bricking the entire save and npc ai suddenly developing new claptrap personality with an aversion to stairs reason 2 combatgameplayas far as gameplaycombat goes everything feels bland after short while in the gameplay preview v is gliding with both horizontal and vertical mobility hacking into network of people using cool and seemingly unique abilities that were going to be based on each play through to achieve their ends the final product feels akin to big brain slow play path utilizing hacking and waiting for cooldowns against very predictable and honestly unengaging ai to pop them or fast fast shooty way which is just running at and emptying ammo into bullet sponges until you get paid reason 3 storythe storyline and quest layout feels like nothing that was promised in the same vein that combat feels bland the storyline also follows up with an inability to deliver on impactful decisionmaking in the witcher 3 game with almost completely set storyline players were still given agency about how they ventured forth in the world through the eyes of geralt of rivia cyberpunk had the express opportunity to deliver on completely open experience citywide palette that could be lovingly painted with each player decision this game is strewn with bunch of samey quests all aligned with the objective of go to x and shoot person with the only caveat of being shoot them quietly to get paid extra the main story while showing sparks of hope with great voice actors and characters like jackie johnny and takemura completely fell on its face to the point that i relegated myself to just doing the samey sidequests until i quit out of boredom knowing that the choices arent actively giving multiple avenues of story for example nearly every scene with timed response was replayed the timed responses have almost 0 impact is an unnecessary fat that either needs to be built upon or cut from the game because it provides complete and utter frustration the life paths also have impact once again taking agency away from the player asking for their own story but not giving them page to write on closing thoughts to reiterate cyberpunk is by far the biggest disappointment to be felt in video game ever this disappointment is amplified because it comes from company that many like myself truly rest all faith upon even after delays many were still in cdprs corner patiently waiting for the game to blow everyones expectations out of the water eagerly awaiting that moment they could say i told you so to all the people questioning the hype and faith some maybe even myself still are reality is slowly closing the door and crushing hope so until this review changes samurai we have other games unavoidable instant kill attacks they spam in an area of effect or they randomize the time in their attack patterns so muscle memory plays against you depending on where the spawnpoint is you will likely have significant backtracking to do before getting instant killed on entering the boss room until you get lucky and they change their attack patternsthis feels less like narrative element of the game and more like transparent way of padding their games length and distract you from how otherwise empty the world isthe best part of the game is the design of the creatures sheep roll around item descriptions but it feels more like yeah all this happened off screen over there and you just missed it as opposed to being world with things happening around youtldr the game is frustrating the bosses feel unfair the quests make sense and you are left checking the wiki for even the basic idea of what to do and the long play time comes from grinding to beat the game as opposed to actual one of the most disappointing bland and empty roleplaying games ive ever played for the most part this review will avoid discussion of technical issuesthe idea of vast immersive and everevolving world set in the cyberpunk universe sounded amazing especially with cdpr behind the wheel with an influx of brilliant pieces of cyberpunk media over the past few years blade runner 2049 mr robot my expectations for the tone this game would take had been set the initial gameplay demo was extremely promising the colour grading art direction voice acting and character creation seemed stellarall of this was changed for the worsethe final product is watereddown simplified washedout experience targeted towards general audiences as opposed to the more hardcore rpg direction shown in the original demo this much was apparent as soon as character creation began the generic skill system lack of the childhood hero mechanic and the incredibly short lifepath segments the prologue of the game is the only worthwhile aspect this is the only part of the game that presents choices decently thoughtout combat encounters and solid writing its worth noting that despite playing out the same sequence as the demo the voice acting taken complete tonal shift the more serious blunt direction been replaced by seemingly more hollywood approach the final product also ditches the more subdued darker colour pallet in favour for something more akin to marvel film muddy dull and washedout after completing the prologue you are thrown into ubisoft open world littered with markers activities and collectablesthis isnt how an open world rpg should operate players should be rewarded for exploration stumbling across side quests and new locations honestly though none of the side quests are actually worth seeking they boil down to go here kill person or go here collect package they play out like bethesdas radiant quest system the only questline i enjoyed was panams judys was fine however the circumstances in which it takes place are unnecessarynarrative is another weakness there are solid character moments and occasions where the writing does shine through but this isnt cyberpunk game it is only that in name and aesthetic lacking any of the nuance speculative fiction and political aspects that make the genre so unique and engaging its exceptionally surface level and feels like someone tried to explain the plot of fight club after constantly falling asleep during it the openworld as whole is disaster civilians dont react to their surroundings the police dont have an actual pursuit system and the combat is albeit easy chore cars cant navigate roads properly traffic lights seem to work in reverse progression is also lacklustre featuring lootershooter and tacky crafting mechanics youll constantly be ditching fun weapon in exchange for one of many ugly firearms skill tree progression is incremental and offers interesting buildvariety the intrinsic way that weapon progression works is detriment to skill progress in order to maintain the power number system your skill specialisations are actually minimal with pitiful increases such as 1 headshot damage increase there is absolutely benefit to putting points into pistols as you could stumble across an assault rifle that is wholly superior and negates your skill progress cyberware is another issue despite some of the effects being interesting they are limited for the sake of balancing although its abundantly clear that you are purposefully held back because the enemy ai are too idiotic and that would make the game even easier than it already isif youre looking for deep thoughtful roleplaying experience i can not recommend this game to you at all if you think some of the mechanics are interesting buy far cry game its the exact same thing just runs better if youre looking for something that offers some thoughtful writing and such play new vegas maybe even give the mass effect trilogy go

im writing this with the understanding that this is very much first impression but after playing it for five hours straight i think i have managed to play enough to form at least basic opinion about this edit ive since put bit more time into the game whilst my opinions remain mostly the same i have some better insight upon some of my feelings and have some other things to mention ill have said changes highlighted in boldive put even more time in now once more my opinions are still strong but some things have changed first and foremost its important to talk about arguably the games primary feature the narrative ill be discussing some very minor spoilers but all of this was shown in trailers years ago so i dont consider that an issue let preface this by saying that player choice and roleplaying as character are all over the place some quests are varied in their options while others are extremely linear even still there are some cases where picking the wrong dialogue option is very clearly discouraged or throws the player into an unfavorable situation for picking something out of character otherwise lot of dialogue options are simply sidecontent that doesnt progress the quest at all further the game throws you in without much explanation night citys backstory is shoved in your face lot but characters are given little time to develop i felt insulted when one of the beginning characters was introduced by six months later actionmovie style cutscene edit this dialogue flaw occurs often but not all the time even still there doesnt seem to be much choice aside from how much of jerk you want to be youre always still v this only seems to get worse once the game opens up not better even outside of the intro character investment and development is strikingly small the game does little to get to care for many of the npc before that npc subsequently disappears dies becomes hostile or otherwise stops being plot relevant i wish more characters stuck around for longer as the ones that do are rather interesting eventually i was happy to see points in which one of my characters skills could be used to bypass dialogue or as an option for quest resolution your choices do begin to matter overtime albeit only in deciding which faction you want to side with at certain points within the game some quests are definitely more linear than others even within the main story track aside from lackluster plot thus far the games world is pretty to look at but quickly loses its shine the repetitive spam of advertisements is delightfully cyberpunk and indicative of the genre but it quickly turns the games background city into an indistinguishable mess thats hard to gather much of anything from the advertisements often seem to grasp the hypersexual nature of the cyberpunk genre but do little with it aside from showing off boobs the sprawling metropolis begins to reveal its flaws very quickly as npc vehicles take turns unrealistically hard clip through objects and even run over other people crowds pop in and out of existence frequently regardless of graphical settingson that note the game runs extremely poorly i am aware that my hardware is far from the latest i7 7700k with gtx 1080 but the game struggles to break even at 50 frames with frequent dips into the 2030 fps range alongside microstuttering if it were any other game i would be more than happy to give this pass its day 1 but even hardware that is far nicer than mine appears to be struggling in some cases and after such an extended delay i am disheartened to see so many graphical visual physical and frameratebased bugs cutscenes will often freeze and stutter objects will pop inandout despite the player standing right next to them textures will unload visually and turning the camera rapidly causes considerable slowdown nearly every physicsbased option in the game is broken in some way and this can be noticed within moments i pray that these issues are fixed with hastethis would be acceptable if there was much of game underneath to enjoy but there is unfortunately not much here driving is floaty and feels more akin to the muscle cars of the 1960s granted i am only driving lowtier cars but cars not only handle poorly they are often outright uncomfortable to drive and hardly have any braking power the roads feel awkward to drive on and invisible walls are prevalent in places that the player is obviously not supposed to drive in to the point that player vehicles are physically warped around at willgunplay is mediocre i dont feel particularly strong one way or the other guns feel fine but being shot little feedback i will definitely compliment the weapon handling while some weapon placement on the screen is awkward the animations and sounds are pretty kickass across the board by far the most annoying part of the games combat loop is the hacking i previously covered some issues with it but i think the most fair assessment is instead to simply call it clunky its inconsistent ranging from annoying to overpowered both in regards to enemy and player usage stealth is fairly standard to the point that it almost feels like it borrows elements from every other stealth game hitman body hiding watchdogs style camera puzzles and assassin creedfar cry style stealth takedowns consist of much of the stealth gameplay i dont hold that against it as all of those systems are quite good but it doesnt do anything unique with it thats finemelee combat is all over the place powerful enemies will teleport to the player and spam attacks that do damage even through the block function that the game provides for you while lower enemies will stand still and wait for you to hit them this inconsistency is indeed telegraphed in their levels and within their quests but the underlying melee combat system is clunky enough to put off i wasnt fan of melee in the fallout series so perhaps its just not for in game like thisplayer customization is surfacelevel at best while there are many expanded options for hair teeth and even eyes the complete lack of body sculpting system is incredibly noticeable i dont necessarily need the ability to customize every single individual triangle of my character model but the fact that my only two body options range between having moderatelylarge pair breasts none at all or giving my character genitalia of some kind was greatly offputting moreover choosing the female option noticeably breaks several cutscenes with player hands clipping through objects from an animation standpoint it is clear that they intended for most players to play as male edit i also wanted to add mild addendum that i did not mention initially the games ux is pretty looking but incredibly irritating to work with there are so many junk items in the game and the hud can become incredibly cluttered at some points even menus have this problem with the skill tree being largely indecipherable blob that requires multiple readings every time the menu is opened summarily i went into cyberpunk 2077 with extremely tempered expectations i was not expecting the game of the century nor was i even expecting the game of the year but i at least expected it to be playable as of the writing of this review the game barely functions on technical level and it hardly holds up from design standpoint otherwise save your money for when the game is patched and is on sale otherwise skip it entirely

after hearing all the fuss about skyrim for many years and seeing it rereleased countless times i decided to give this game try and i regret to say that i was absolutely underwhelmed by it ill try to articulate the reasons as clearly as possible spoilers belowif i had to describe the game in single phrase it would be wide as an ocean deep as puddle right from the beginning the game lot going on you have storyline about the civil war in skyrim and another one about dragons coming back to the world plus many more subplots theres gigantic world to explore with an inordinate amount of dungeons and just as many quests and more than dozen skills with their associated skilltree but most of these elements are spread very thinquests the approach they took here is quantity over quality by light year you cant go two meters without getting quest from somebody but the overwhelming majority are glorified and sometimes not even that fetch quests you either have to collect specific item certain number of common items clear dungeon or kill certain enemy then get the reward thats the long and the short of it credit where credit is due some quests are bit more interesting and have more work put into it like the daedric quests but they are very small minority and end up drowned into the endless barrage of inane babys first quest the game keeps throwing at youthe dungeons are different you get them in three flavors cave ancient tomb or castle with couple of dwarventhemed ones which would be fine if there werent over hundred dungeons so seeing the exact same palette gets really old after while although the designers decided to go the extra mile in some cases and throw couple of trees or bushes in the cave maps so theres that i also would like to mention that im willing to believe bethesda was contractually obligated to put puzzles in the game or something like that because the puzzles are the bare minimum thing that could still be legally considered puzzle usually with the solution right above them because god forbid players have to think for couple secondsmain storyline the first sequencetutorial failed completely to make feel invested in the story and the but thou must feeling was the only thing that carried forward from storytelling perspective my character had little to incentive to go to whiterun after escaping the dragon attack to draw comparison with similar games fallout 3 starts with your father disappearing and you having to track him fallout new vegas starts with you being robbed and almost killed the dragonborn such personal stake on moving the plot forward it gradually starts to appear as the story progresses but its insufficient the characterization is anemic as well further contributed by the classic bethesda move we have 300 npcs but 6 voice actors so half the city sounds the same i dont expect an individual voice actor for every minor npc but it was so blatant it bordered on immersionbreakingcivil war storyline this one showed promise at first it was presented as significant element in the story at the beginning but ends up being completely optional barebones thread not much characterization is provided to either side besides the empire is trying to annex skyrim as part of its territory and the stormcloaks want skyrim to stay independent i dont know how it is for the stormcloaks but after joining the empire i completed dungeon and after whiteruns defense it devolved into series of attack this castlekill this group of soldiers until storming windhelm and killing ulfric and that was the end of it other than passing comments from random npcs there wasnt much acknowledgement of the situation and in classic bethesda move general tullius mentions we should root out the stormcloak camps after the last battle but the game forgot to mark the captains of each camp as nonessential and they were unkillable subplots mage college thieves guild etc while these are some more fleshedout questlines they are slowburn but somewhat serviceable at best the companions and the dark brotherhood to the plot being out there mages college or acceptable but then making you grind like crazy in order to complete the last chapter thieves guild along with dawnguard the characters are at least bit more defined and theres some focus on different facets of gameplay or new aspects ie vampire and werewolf formsskills and gameplay there are several skills several combat related along with an interesting crafting system while the combat system plausibly seems to offer several approaches one of the main problems of the crafting system when it comes to leveling up is that there are means to increase the acquisition of raw materials but the experience requirements for each level get progressively steeper making it increasingly grindy and an absolute chore on the last levels and even then theres not incentive on behalf of the game to focus on crafting as you have several shopkeepers whose products scale with level and its pretty easy to get gold incidentally the main bottleneck here is usually the shopkeepers gold supplyall in all the ideas presented are nice but the execution on several key aspects particularly storytelling really hamstrings the enjoyment im willing to give it bit of pass as it may not have aged particularly well but if i hadnt been for achievement hunting id probably rushed the main quest after while and wrapped it up much sooner as it stands i dont think ill ever touch this game again

collision bugs ive been thrust into the sky as high as skyscraper when i brushed past car once ai is abysmal they will attempt to shoot you through walls and doors never hitting you they will find let just start by saying that if you like this game youve won the argument by virtue of enjoying something im struggling to if youre having fun thats great if youre besotted with the world thats fair and youre not wrong nothing in this review is intended to piss off the hive i just have to write about the impressions i honestly feelcyberpunk 2077 is game that is unforgivably marred by one thing and one thing only overpromotion thesis could be written on how audacious cyberpunks marketing been the hype train is of course not all cdprs fault but the false promises are releasing too early and expecting you to pay 50 for the privilege of being an unofficial beta tester is look i work in marketing so i know how it goes but when you promise so much and know you cant deliver on it and change your marketing material in order to refer to the game as an actionadventure rather than an rpg before release well it doesnt sit right with if ubisoft had done this i would have blown my top i have to stay consistentlet make this clear i was not on the hype train for this game hype makes feel nervous and i try to deaden myself to it im also realistic i understood that it takes more for game to be developed in the currentgen to offer truly nextgeneration experience and found it miracle that red dead redemption 2 by contrast was so incredibly detailed and complex if less dense than this title im also not stickler for bugs i know theyll get patched and fixed and that performance will improve what i did expect however is what was promised in this game there is advanced vehicle ai which means police chases simply can not happen thats system that was present in grand theft auto vice city npcs are lifeless and are barely worth interacting with the world strong art direction and can look quite beautiful at times but its far from breathing and routinely feels shallow and tired thanks to how repetitive and basic the npc and traffic routines are it reminds of mafia game where the open world is just set dressing serving effectively as long loading screen as you move from place to place but this isnt how the game was marketed from the offset they outright promised sandbox rpg featuring incredibly dense and novel npc interactions and narrative paths i didnt buy into everything they said of course but when your world is even less impressive than the last watch dogs game i have to wonder whats going onthe gunplay is punchy despite the inconsistent ballistics the upgrade tree is relatively cool if deceptively limited and the momenttomoment gameplay is all just serviceable its not an rpg i find to be particularly deep this is somewhat moot point but theres little gameplay here you havent already seen achieved more competently in titles like sleeping dogs deus ex and fallout driving feels dated as if the vehicles have substantial momentum to them its the little details that are truly noticeable like v not even sleeping correctly in his bed or qol considerations like the lack of dedicated walk button on keyboard that culminates in making the game feel average at best i have idea what happened with the life paths i was led to believe they would be as long and impactful as the origin stories in dragon age origins but theyre just 20minute starter sequences geared to introduce you to the world at breakneck speed they feel like cut contentthe good stuff here involves both the reliably impressive writing and story sequences yet thanks to the limited input you have for roleplaying it regularly feels like youre watching very cool television show its nowhere near as reactive and dynamic i had hoped not even half as much as the witcher 2 if this game only featured its story front and centre i would have given this positive review however it doesnt and i cant give thumbs up for undercooked ambition or good writing when its less than 25 of the experience especially with all this mediocre fluff surrounding it i say that even as someone who is willing to tolerate much for good story the amazing sequences you see are ironically those that would make for the best trailerbait and oh boy did theycyberpunks writing is far from perfect though especially in its presentation and pacing im never provided the means to care about v at all thanks to his introductory montage youre given relationships professional contacts and criminal reputation in the space of around two minutes its hard to get your bearings compare this to kingdom come deliverance where the horrific origins of henrys developing heroism are fullyplayable rooted grounded in your humble status it helps you build your own relationship to his ambition ambition that stays with you throughout the game theres nothing like that herea side note its very easy to assume that its the fault of those who are heavily involved in watching the press cycle for getting their own hopes up buying into every oped andor preview carefully curated to generate clicks and escalating excitement for the game unfortunately you would also have to be blind to the design patterns and trends of the last ten years to not see how derivative the vast majority of cyberpunks systems are its not bad thing to be derivative not always but if youve marketed your game as being anything but that from day one well people are going to noticei have doubt this game will improve in the next year in terms of its optimisation performance bugsquashing and maybe even additional content for now i would advise onthefence newcomers to steer well clear i would also recommend that you stay sceptical of people who want to lambast absolutely everything in this game as well as those who somehow think critical impressions are misguided at best or hate at worst certain elements of this game have been crafted with noticeable care and heartfelt attention to detail such as the side quests which can show real glimpses of brilliance i imagine few of the actual developers want to strangle the marketing and management teams right now and trust i get iti would have likely brushed this off as fine sometimes aboveaverage game ignoring the bugs and lack of innovative features as simply par for the course i may have given it positive review if it were honestly janky but featurecomplete closer to the promises we were given what i cant do is positively review product sold under wilfully and repeatedly false pretences thats weird for because i dont usually take principled stand if you can label cringe review as that i didnt much care about epic strongarming their way into the market for instance im not entirely sure how much of this ad campaign was straight deception on cdprs part and how much of it was comprised of wellwishing narratives that exploded out of control magnified by the sacred reputation gamers had anointed them with all while they found their feet in new and strange genre for whatever reason this time it feels odious maybe im just getting old

i kept myself from reading anything about the game because i wanted to go in blindly and experience it entirely for myself the only thing i knew for certain was that keanu reeves was in it which his performance never disappointed you start with having to choose three different ways to go which is what i assumed would be different storylines but they are not apparently everyone the same exact storyline but different outcomes based on the choices at least some of the choices you make for example you romance character successfully you get an ending with the character blah blah blah whatever the main storyline was not very fulfilling to say the least and i think it could have had much more potentialnight city was also quite disappointing night city was just not really what id expect modern metropolis in the year 2077 to look like especially with how much technology had advanced within the game i thought itd have bit more of cyberpunk feel to it but it too was underwhelming however i liked being able to see something new after turning each street corner and coming across little details like the nicer kept up parts of the city the spray painted walls of buildings in the not so nice parts and the windmills and cactus in the badlands and seeing many many different npcs but my god are the npcs one of the most annoying things ever ive never been so annoyed by games npcs before if you point your gun at them while theyre in their car or if youre trying to steal their car they do absolutely nothing when running across the street they will run you over and dont even stop nor will they stop if youre close enough to them to be detected and theyll just run you over and keep going i got extremely and quickly annoyed with them and i also got bit annoyed with how many npcs there were in one place at times yeah sure its city with lot of people and that would be expected but i really doubt there would actually be hundreds of people on city streets at 2 am like great example of the opposite would be gta the npcs run out of their car when theres gun pointed at them they stop their cars when they accidentally hit you at least gtas npcs have some respect for the people they hit it really is the little things and speaking of cars i hate how the vehicles drive in cyberpunk i really do not know what it is with the vehicles but i just hated them they were not fun to driveive had to restart the game to different checkpoint because some npcs that are part of the storyline or side quests would bug out and get stuck onto objects or within doorways and they wouldnt moveother bugs included the object info box popping up on the right and staying stuck there until i restarted the game enemies not taking any sort of damage had to restart the game for that too and at one point transparent black box in the bottom middle of the screen that also needed the game to be restarted and the characters not speaking but their dialogue is still popping up theres lot of other little things that were pretty noticeable but at least it wasnt entirely making the game unplayabledespite the underwhelming storyline and overall feeling of disappointment i did enjoy few things from the game i found myself really enjoying and taking liking to the quickhack ability i was not very fond of the combat and found myself sticking to staying stealthy and using quickhacks i liked the quickhack ability and thought it was fun i like how youre given lot of side quests it gives you lot to do as matter of fact because i was quite disappointed with how the main storyline was playing out i lollygagged and spent lot of time doing side quests before forcing myself to play through the rest of the game the side quests felt bit more fulfilling than the main story which i dont think is good sign i did enjoy the different personalities the characters were given v included it really builds character and that bit felt somewhat immersive but its not enough to say that the game is worth itthe main storyline was just quite underwhelming and disappointing and it felt quite rushed i honestly thought there could have been more to it i really feel like the game was rushed just to be released if cdpr had just given it another year at least i think it would have been much better but overall i am quite disappointed and unhappy with the experience ive had

get in the witcher i get that 1st person melee combat is totally different but there are ways to do it right this is not it also the fistfighting is utter crap and so buggy it takes lot of luck to improvement some vehicles feel great while others are almost undrivable quadro turbo r looking at you what really needs improvement here is vehicle mass which you can really feel during collisions crashing into another car feels so so so fake and unrealistic its like both cars are made out of cardboard and some cars will literally just drive right under other cars at high speeds the worst part of all this though is the laughable racing missions the opponent vehicles dont even actually race you but just spawn alongside you if you get too far ahead too far behind and they cant actually blow up your car when they shoot at you or vice versa what in the world were the developers thinking here i have idea these races could be so much fun if they made them actual races with intelligent driving ai and realistic vehicle mass and damage instead once i realized im not racing at all these missions were so dumb challenge at all and they are the only racing offered in the whole game so clearly they didnt intend to flesh out the racing idea which is really frustrating why even bother teasing us with the idea why pour so much attention and energy into the vehicles in this game and not tattoos nothing guns you can add few mods that arent visual switch out couple of scopes and choose between couple of silencers thats it and vehicles nothing you cant even pick the color of your car clothes you can add statchanging mods but thats it customizing or color changing or even way to neatly organize them god forbid you want to put together cohesive closet for v good luck finding the exact shade of that particular jacket youre looking for big thumbs down here for an rpg game that heavily flaunts customization and screenshot photography tools that implies it cares about aestheticsall in all to say im disappointed is an understatement even if this game ever fully address its myriad of issues and adds more content and customization features at the point things are at free to disagreein terms of combat elden ring added posture break from bloodborne this feature innately encourages you to be on the offensive in order to benefit from it however the bosses in elden ring are some of the most aggressive bosses that have ever graced the soulsborne series they often leave very little window for you to take advantage of especially if you use strengthbased slow weapon you might need to keep dodging the bosss flurries of attacks before you get to poke it once with your ultra greatsword before going back to dodging again this is in direct contrast with the posture system because you are encouraged to be aggressive yet you often cant this led to some players opting to grind out as many levels as they could before fighting boss so that they can simply trade hits with it and win with their raw stats in my opinion this is horrible combat design many bosses have animations that are specifically designed to trick you into dodging early which i do not mind in itself but it does get tiresome when every single boss and their mother starts to do itanother thing to note is that bosses will longer follow through any predetermined combos what i mean is that boss may terminate their combo once they detect you have gotten too far away for them to hit so instead of finishing their combo they would simply stop and reset this further reduces the windows of opportunity that players have to get some damage in the difference between what the player can do versus what the enemies can do in my opinion again have exceeded what constitutes as fair but challenging you are again encouraged to wear heavy armour with high poise so you can just trade hits with bossesspeaking of bosses it seems to that they reuse boss enemies little too often take for instance the godskin duo you get to fight the skinny one you get the fight the fat one you get to fight the spirit version of the skinny one you get to fight the spirit version of the skinny one and then the spirit version of the fat one you get to fight the skinny one along with the fat one you probably end up fighting the godskins over or close to 10 times throughout the gamei know that this is not your traditional action games like the dmc series or nioh but i think the combat system of the soulsborne series deserves better revamp than just adding in the ability to jump however the innate flaw of the combat system alone is not what made wanting to give it bad review i think one can still argue that the essence of soulsborne game lies within the clunky gameplay the buggy camera is part of the challenge as some have arguedwhat truly made not wanting to leave positive review is on the technical side the game advertises coop play with friends yet it still uses the exact same clunky summon system from previous games during coop you lose your ability to ride your horse which was one of the more heavily advertised features of the game mind you and had to travel through the vast open world on foot want to travel to somewhere that one of your friends still havent explored you got ta run there with them sometimes you encounter fog walls on the edge of zones that you have to dismiss all your summoned friends before you may cross it and you have to resummon your friends again just inches away from where they left you just so you may cross that fog wall why man justwhy this alone is not bad enough to discourage coop play the server horrible connection issues i would be sitting right next to my partner as she tries to summon and disconnecting from her world completely players get to invade you i know that this is feature that been presence for forever in the soulsborne series but i serious believe that the game is better off without it passive play as it always been is the king in any form of pvp in the soulsborne series the world of elden ring is tough so venturing into difficult enemies npcs with hostile player keep on spamming weapon art that takes away 23 of your hp is nothing but frustrating so the host and their summons would just stay near to the bonfire or grace in this game and not progress the level the invader being constantly outnumbered is also encouraged to hide behind enemies so that they have better winning chance this leads to the absurd sometimes hilarious situations where one does anything once an invasion happens both parties are waiting for the other side to lose their patience first once players actually happen to fight each other lag determines huge portion of the outcome i have turned off crossregion play and yet i could would be overall beneficialanother huge point of frustration for about elden ring is the huge input lag and action queue window the soulsborne series run on the same fairly dated engine and its action queue which is perhaps my biggest gripe this game queues your actions for instance you can initiate command to dodge but get hit by an attack perhaps because you dodged too late and the game queues that dodge command so that is acted upon as soon as your character becomes free this leads to the absurd situation where you get hit by an attack and your character dodges automatically after being hit often at the wrong time without any additional input from you and dies because you dodged again at bad time all this because you were fraction of second too late on your initial dodge this much damageive just finished fighting miquella and one of the summons i got two in fact due to multiple attempts used this katana and shredded the bosss health in couple of attacksso this weapon is insanely good for bosses paired with pose and less damage on the mixed physicknow this is for pve for bosses so as you can imagine in pvp the issue is about as problematic as it seems long range bleed lingering hitboxes that dont make ton of sense sometimes or are just annoying that and the combos are either insanely fast or ridiculously slowwhat do i mean with all of this well elden ring was tailor made to screw up with souls gamers timings really screwing with what we had known from previous games to prevent it from being too easy for legacy players while i accept the difficulty change update finished the game after 60 or so hours including the secret areas ive skipped some optional ruins and minor dungeons gon na leave the original review below for reference again this review wont talk about performance and optimization issues widely acknowledged by everyone and still hopefully to be patched sooner or laterfirst the good its always nice to be back to souls games the formula behind these games is winning one addicting charming challenging they are good games and with the right mindset very enjoyable ones elden ring is different in that sense it manages to deliver the same engrossing experience we all came to love during these years for the record ive been playing souls games since demons soul which remains still one of my favoritesnow lets tackle the issues ive got with elden ring the gameplay formula is my main gripe here there are other problems i will address later but this here is the true source of my frustration which inevitably spoiled most of the enjoyment i had people say that it all started with ds3 but personally i believe it was slow process of memification of the souls genre gameplay the git gud mentality behind it all which steered all design decisions towards what i consider now pure cbt and ultimately unfun experience the perfect summary ive read around is it feels youre playing dark souls while every enemy is playing bloodborneslow uncancellable animations are sometimes so annoying it feels youre playing with 500 ping all the time most of the bosses and even enemies are hysterical aoe spamming madlads with perfect hit tracking inconceivable hitboxes and so many aoe moves that sometimes they feel copypasted imagine pontiff sulyvahn on crack not enough ok now imagine zoning aoe bosses sorta like laurence of crack thats 90 of how i felt my experience with elden ringand it makes sad to think about bosses like rennala it felt like i was fighting real witch the fire giant aoe monster but slow and earth shattering or even the stupid mimic how unique and interesting they felt even radahn had an incredible concept but holy mother of god in the end it became spam to summon meat puppets and dodge the oneshot hitsim not gon na talk about maleniaim not gon na do ittoo soon said that the other secondary but still quite perceivable issue ive got here is the amount of recycled content and how derivative most if the world feels is the open world empty not really but i believe theyve chosen quantity over quality the more i played the more i felt diminishing returns in exploration and boss fighting enjoymentsome bosses appear again and again during the game sometimes as minibosses sometimes as slightly reskinned new bosses sometimes oh wait theres two now areas start repeating themselves very soon and biomes only offer some respite in the creeping familiarity that inevitably kicks in after whilethe most jarring example of this is the siofra river area and boss design absolutely incredible gameplay of the area not really fan of aimbot snipers but hey its easily rushable so whatever boss simple fascinating one of the most memorable music track in the game they basically copypasted everything from lightning the beacons to unlock the boss fight to the boss fight itself with couple of added gimmick moves why not only it feels cheap but it manages to take out the beauty and uniqueness of the area you encountered the first timeso yeah i confirm my suspicions of my early review elden ring feels like step back for from software compared to bloodborne or sekiro not only its their comfort zone its the festering blight town comfort zone where the souls franchise is now sitting in semistagnation open world and jumping are not enough to call it the most daring souls ever madegood game yesmediocre souls also yesoriginal reviewelden ring is classic souls game exactly what youd expect which is why i find it disappointing i find the raving reviews talking about the most daring and ambitious souls game ever misleading compared to the dark souls franchises gameplay elden ring doesnt feel much different iframe rolls parries critical attacks jump attacks are just another way to trigger them poke and repeat bloodborne game from 2015 tried to innovate the formula in more meaningful way and it felt different at least tiny bit sekiro released before elden ring completely revolutionized the formula and soaked it in crystal meth how can you say that elden ring is the most ambitious souls game when older souls game tried so much harder to shake things up sadly to elden ring feels like step backthe open world aspect feels gimmicky way to follow nowadays trend where every game should have crafting system and faraway mountain you can go to the world so far felt empty just bland grassland linking together various areas and dungeons some of which are truly wondrous siofra river anyone but most got saying ive been here beforeall souls game feel like rites of passage with sweat and pain you git gud and when you git gud you are able to delve deeper in mysterious world or enjoy gorgeous new scenery or have the chance to wreck new abominations ass this time the suffering is starting to feel bit more pointless which is shameis it good game yesis it good souls game so far ive found it uninspired and bland one of the weakest of the franchise

after almost 80 hours and completing every side mission in the game i finally finished cyberpunk 2077 so far im not sure how i feel about the ending but i certainly have thoughts about the rest of the game while i wasnt as much into the hype as others i still preordered and got up in the middle of the night to play on launch dayi have never felt so ambivalent about game before its not 310 or 610 or 1010 because i can not possibly merge the things i loved and the things i hated into one score heres my random thoughts on the aspects that i liked and those i really didntthe goodnight city my god what beautiful vast varied place at times the lighting and colours reached level of perfection reminiscent of control sundown in the desert was damn near photorealistic at times and dont get started on the grimy gloomy perfection that is japantown and little chinastarting out i went into most gigs as stealthy hacker and got very frustrated with the unreliable detection system and how difficult it was to tell whether an enemy could be taken out safely with quickhack or not then i tried going in guns blazing instead and suddenly i was playing doom seriously the music the pacing jumping and sliding all over the place it felt pretty much like doom and i loved it played the rest of the game as complete badass with an assault rifle and the occasional quickhackthe narrative is solid disregarding the disappointing tease that is act 1 there is lot to love here as someone who primarily plays games for the story i was hooked fairly soon and found myself caring for many of the characters some of the main missions were absolutely breathtaking heh and i enjoyed all the long conversations great deal as they were very well written the endings are bit of mixed bag though and i can not possibly see how any dlc could pick up where they left offthe music the soundtrack is awesome especially the doomesque combat music but what i absolutely fell in love with was the samurai tracks by refused will be listening to never fade away chippin in and black dog for many months to comejohnny ill eat every last bullet in the city for you if thats what its going to take sniffthe badthe original story line and premise were probably scrapped at some point in development to be replaced by what we have now bits of it can still be found in the life paths and the entire act 1 leaving decidedly bitter taste of what could have been while i like the narrative that we did get i felt that act 1 promised very different game and it should have been several hours longer at the very least developing that friendship with jackie should never have been relegated to an action montage the game tells you briefly why v cares about jackie but it never tells you why you the player should and so it all falls flatcustomisation there is none why do i sink hours upon hours into open world rpgs because i can customise my character to t on my adventures appearance equipment weapons mountsvehicles perks i was so certain there would be barbers and tattoo parlors in this game i didnt even bother looking it up in reality there is nothing visual customisation at all and the stat customisation is utterly boring you can replace your eyeballs but you cant cut your hair there is vehicle customisation whatsoever visible weapon customisation either and i fail to see where 5 limb damage mods is compelling personalisation of your equipment there are many perks but the vast majority of them is as boring and uninspired as the weaponclothing mods there was plenty of misleading marketing but this for was the worst fashion is everything in night city off there isnt even single decent hat in the entire townthere is roleplaying dialogue options are very basic and decisions far and few between v is not going to change based on your actions or at all really romance options are limited to say the least to avoid spoilers ill simply say that after getting together theres nothing more going to happen until the very end oh you can move in with your love interest that is an icon will appear on your map designating their place as one of your apartments safe house but there is absolutely point unless cdpr seriously expects to drive across town to make stupid faces in my boyfriends mirrorthe npcs and ai this been discussed in many places so i wont go into too much detail whenever danger breaks out npcs crouch down into generic position that looks like placeholder sometimes they panic because i sprint the police system is complete joke they dont give when i go on rampage trying to drive my bloody car but for some reason get real touchy when i look at them while passing byafter many years of modding skyrim i thought i was resistant enough to not be annoyed by any bugs i might encounter boy was i wrong the glitches visual and otherwise just happen constantly taking crap on immersion at every turn quests get stuck and require you to reload an earlier save during one long main mission 5 second audio loop from an earlier cutscene got stuck for about ten minutes playing over relevant dialogue since the mission kept going i couldnt savereload to fix it either so it ruined the whole thing at least the game didnt crash on yaythe performance ranges from decent to utterly atrocious i realise that my processor is getting somewhat outdated i5 7600k 42ghz and was certainly bottlenecking my gpu rtx 3080 bought specifically for cyberpunk playing at 1440p with many of the settings turned down and crowd density set to medium my frame rate would still drop below 20 in the downtown area which is bad joke outside the city it sat at comfortable 7080fps but as soon as i got closer to the city centre the game turned into sluggish unresponsive messthe conclusioni enjoyed the game great deal i am also severely disappointed cyberpunk 2077 is rough unpolished experience that clearly needed more time in the oven whats there is for the most part very good but constantly overshadowed by what could have beenoverall i just can not recommend the game in its current state

university to put it simply cp2077 been long time coming it been said countless times before but i still feel like its important to be seen if you have been eating breathing drinking sleeping about cp2077 and took everything cdpr showed us as gospel you will be disappointed if you thought this game was the return of jesus christ or the cure for cancer or that its release would somehow revert all the misery 2020 seems to infinitely produce you will be disappointed and unfortunately that is your fault for thinking so the game is with some exceptions of course mile wide but an inch deep its also great until it isnt allow to explain that further cp2077 tries incredibly hard to suck you into its world and 9 times out of 10 it truly works in my play time i have never been so sucked into fictional world than cp2077 characters like jackie or panam are incredibly fleshed out their dialogue and scenes with your character are truly some of the best in the industry in those scenes i feel like im there talking to them not v but then that 1 out of 10 times happen perhaps jackie tposes during an incredibly inopportune time or maybe panam just decides to venture off to the shadow realm midconversation leaving you talking to yourself maybe your car will turn into submarine if you hit lamp post and take you under the map at jusssst the right angle its these funny to gamebreaking bugs and glitches that really take you out of the simulation that cdpr tried so hard at creating making you remember that this is just game the map is gorgeous thats undeniable cdpr put lot of detail into night city and its surrounding locales from the immaculate areas where the rich and corporations are situated to the industrial slums that surround it all the way to the grimy oil fields and dirty badlands however its just that there is depth to the map whatsoever cdpr tired to counteract this with side missions gigs and mini missions dressed up as police dispatches they even dressed up car purchases as missions to bloat up the map i managed to complete every mission offered in the game and i have compelling reason to return to the game sadly there are not lot of open buildings you can explore while the map size is generously large the map itself is cut up and gerrymandered in such way that the map size is more of an illusion for example the playable area of the district of pacifica is only half of what the map implies as for graphics i have modest rig with the exception of 2080 and everything ran smoothly on high settings i decided to leave the film grain option on and while that may be controversial move im glad i kept it seeing the grain interact with the night sky and the light pollution remind of movies like driveheatblade runner or my old photos on my film camera perhaps its nostalgia talking but i thought it looked great as for the story i wont reveal much for the sake of people who wish not to be spoiled the first act is definitely the most polished and i wish that it was stretched out this is not to say that the rest of the plot is trash but it is noticeable when cdpr heard feedback from some players say that the story for witcher 3 was too long for them which i think is crazy but i digress they scrambled to trim some fat i also do wish that the missions that dictate your character nomad street corp were longer or more important as at the end of your first mission v will be identical matter what life path you chose for the rest of the game the main side missions were all really well executed most notably panam who id argue is the most fleshed out character after v and silverhand the dialog choices you are presented are more fallout 4 than deus ex the music was really well done the original soundtrack was fantastic the radio stations were good but could get repetitive i for one really enjoyed the jazz station for nice change of pace compared to the other stations that kinda blended into one in my opinion gameplay was fine i used controller for majority of my playthrough and experienced little to issues with input driving was passable but only just i swear that the brakes dont work as intended as i have to brake football field ahead of turn gunplay was fine more cod than typical rpg which im not complaining about the part where i actually say if you should buy the game or not so would i recommend the game thats an incredibly tough question to answer its really all in the mindset of who is purchasing the game if you are someone who had calendar date for the games release bought merch and complained that it got delayed multiple times i would not purchase it lets be honest here you already did buy it if you were expecting this game to be such technological marvel and game changer that keanu reeves himself comes out of your monitor and give you huge kiss on the lips and tuck you into your bed every night i would not purchase it if you were someone who was interested in the game but didnt fall for the hype train i would wait for this game to go on sale you are not missing out on anything important personally i bought this game because i had deus ex itch that needed to be scratched and it did it similarities to deus ex but is also separate enough to be somewhat fresh breath of air for if the devs at eidos are peeking around the level design and story of mankind dividedhuman revolution and the controlcombat of cp2077 would be fantastic so if youre in the same boat as i was and craving some more jc or adam jensen action this is the next best thing but wait for sale if you want to purchase this game at its current state i strongly advise you wait for decent sale only if cdpr make some drastic improvements and quality of life would i recommend this game at full price its shame as i was as an avid soulsborne player i really tried and gave this game my all i wanted to like it so badly but i cant bring myself to even complete second playthrough this review will contain spoilers so i advise skipping this review unless you have thoroughly completed the gamefirstly id like to start off with the great things this game doesbetter melee variety i love how there are different viable attacks when fighting with melee weapons ashes of war while some are quite busted is great mechanic to shake up monotonous melee combat i love that charged strong attacks and jumping attacks are not only viable but some of the strongest attacks you can do i love how shields can be altered and tweaked to match your build wonderfully and how useful they feel when performing guard breaksworld design aesthetics this game while being soulslike does an amazing job at separating itself from the look of the other souls games the highfantasy themes really show through in this games most beautiful areas even enemies and bosses themselves look amazing this game easily the best visuals aesthetics and design out of all of fromsoftwares current titlesexploration sense of scale level design this game feels massive with so many different things you can do and so many enemies to fight the legacy dungeons are all so fun to explore and make for some of the most classic soulsborne gameplaynow on to the cons i have with the gameboss enemy design truly the most upsetting thing about this game for the simplest way to sum up this issue is that it feels as if your character in elden ring is from dark souls 1 and the enemies are ported from dark souls 3 i really have issues with bosses having neverending combos of attacks granted that i have the equal and opposite ability to properly react and evade the combat in elden ring often feels challenging in the wrong way bosses more often than not have combos that never seem to end and also an apparent fetish for aoe moves i also find the bosses enjoy falling into loop of repeating moves time and time again spamming the same moves until your corpse is butchered to pulp my character ended the game with 60 vitality and it still felt like i never had enough hp armour seems to have little to purpose as i have to invest in endurance and sacrifice one trinket slot to have dollar tree version of havels ring in order to wear armour that feels stronger than paper mache the amount of repeated bosses in this game is really disheartening after exploring catacomb 59 and finding the misbegotten warrior and another trash mob in an arena the sense to explore is fleeting feeling it is tragic and feels horribly lazy and undercooked other fight drives this point home better than the godskin duo if youve been playing the game to the highest extent then youve fought these enemies multiple times caelid tower the witches village volcano manor etc already youve seen these bosses far too many times to count however the creme creme is awaiting you at the crumbling faram azura where you have to fight them for one last hurrah both at the same time this is an essential fight you need to do to beat the game i really implore anyone that avidly enjoys this game what was the purpose of putting this fight there i find myself asking this question far often than i should when i encounter reused boss in an area that didnt need bossit seems that major strategy of elden ring is to avoid engaging with the boss most if not every challenging boss follows this same logic fighting radhan just hit him couple times stage one then spam the summons second stage and never attack him directly fighting melania just stunlock her and use mimic tear to take aggro off you so when she uses her 1000 hit combo the fight just doesnt abruptly end the list goes on with people listing just use bleed bloody slash use magic use x ash of war and spam it until theyre dead use the rotten stray and proc scarlet rot insert exploit here none of these are proper solutions did you feel sense of accomplishment when you bloody slashed the 27th boss to death did you feel satisfied when your mimic tear summon soloed the boss did you have fun watching scarlet rot tick down that boss youve been struggling to beat you shouldnt have to respec to fight certain bosses every fight should have viable solutions and sense that every playstyle chance to win whether that chance be low or high it should always feel possible and it shouldnt feel like the odds are so stacked against you that you have to make do and essentially exploit the game to continue onthis entire game comes to climax inside the erd tree in easily the most disappointing final boss in all of souls i still remember the first time i fought gwyn gherman and the soul of cinder each of these games built up their final fights so immensely well it was challenge i was overjoyed with walking through the fog gate into gwyns boss room is feeling i will never feel again the dread knowing that everything that ive accomplished come to this final moment and when i win i can finally fulfil the prophecy foretold to i felt nothing when i got to the elden beast i felt sense of accomplishment joy fear happiness just nothing it felt like nothing had led up to that point there was buildup emotion struggle sense of accomplishment just gauntlet of two mediocre bosses back to backi really tried to enjoy this game i really did but the boss design in this game really brings it down many pegs for and kills all replayability this game ever could have if you enjoyed this game im happy for you but i just want to voice my feelings for others that may have felt the same way if you didnt like the game thats ok if you did im happy you enjoyed it and could see past the things i took issue withoverall as soulslike this game simply does not do it for and maybe others may share my feelings as well

choices do begin to matter overtime albeit only in deciding which faction you want to side with at certain points within the game some quests are definitely more linear than others even within the main story track aside from lackluster plot thus far the games world is pretty to look at but quickly loses its shine the repetitive spam of advertisements is delightfully cyberpunk and indicative of the genre but it quickly turns the games background city into an indistinguishable mess thats hard to gather much of anything from the advertisements often seem to grasp the hypersexual nature of the cyberpunk genre but do little with it aside from showing off boobs the sprawling metropolis begins to reveal its flaws very quickly as npc vehicles take turns unrealistically hard clip through objects and even run over other people crowds pop in and out of existence frequently regardless of graphical settingson that note the game runs extremely poorly i am aware that my hardware is far from the latest i7 7700k with gtx 1080 but the game struggles to break even at 50 frames with frequent dips into the 2030 fps range alongside microstuttering if it were any other game i would be more than happy to give this pass its day 1 but even hardware that is far nicer than mine appears to be struggling in some cases and after such an extended delay i am disheartened to see so many graphical visual physical and frameratebased bugs cutscenes will often freeze and stutter objects will pop inandout despite the player standing right next to them textures will unload visually and turning the camera rapidly causes considerable slowdown nearly every physicsbased option in the game is broken in some way and this can be noticed within moments i pray that these issues are fixed with hastethis would be acceptable if there was much of game underneath to enjoy but there is unfortunately not much here driving is floaty and feels more akin to the muscle cars of the 1960s granted i am only driving lowtier cars but cars not only handle poorly they are often outright uncomfortable to drive and hardly have any braking power the roads feel awkward to drive on and invisible walls are prevalent in places that the player is obviously not supposed to drive in to the point that player vehicles are physically warped around at willgunplay is mediocre i dont feel particularly strong one way or the other guns feel fine but being shot little feedback i will definitely compliment the weapon handling while some weapon placement on the screen is awkward the animations and sounds are pretty kickass across the board by far the most annoying part of the games combat loop is the hacking i previously covered some issues with it but i think the most fair assessment is instead to simply call it clunky its inconsistent ranging from annoying to overpowered both in regards to enemy and player usage stealth is fairly standard to the point that it almost feels like it borrows elements from every other stealth game hitman body hiding watchdogs style camera puzzles and assassin creedfar cry style stealth takedowns consist of much of the stealth gameplay i dont hold that against it as all of those systems are quite good but it doesnt do anything unique with it thats finemelee combat is all over the place powerful enemies will teleport to the player and spam attacks that do damage even through the block function that the game provides for you while lower enemies will stand still and wait for you to hit them this inconsistency is indeed telegraphed in their levels and within their quests but the underlying melee combat system is clunky enough to put off i wasnt fan of melee in the fallout series so perhaps its just not for in game like thisplayer customization is surfacelevel at best while there are many expanded options for hair teeth and even eyes the complete lack of body sculpting system is incredibly noticeable i dont necessarily need the ability to customize every single individual triangle of my character model but the fact that my only two body options range between having moderatelylarge pair breasts none at all or giving my character genitalia of some kind was greatly offputting moreover choosing the female option noticeably breaks several cutscenes with player hands clipping through objects from an animation standpoint it is clear that they intended for most players to play as male edit i also wanted to add mild addendum that i did not mention initially the games ux is pretty looking but incredibly irritating to work with there are so many junk items in the game and the hud can become incredibly cluttered at some points even menus have this problem with the skill tree being largely indecipherable blob that requires multiple readings every time the menu is opened summarily i went into cyberpunk 2077 with extremely tempered expectations i was not expecting the game of the century nor was i even expecting the game of the year but i at least expected it to be playable as of the writing of this review the game barely functions on technical level and it hardly holds up from design standpoint otherwise save your money for when the game is patched and is on sale otherwise skip it entirely

antagonists maelstrom in particular all have their own motives interests history ambitions that made so fascinated in their lives and build connection with each the side jobs involving each of these characters continued that great writing and was some of the best content in the game river wards and peralez questline being highlight but there is also memorable content that doesnt involve the main cast such as sentient vending machine or talking handgun wanting to be returned to its owner however the problem with the side content is that they are all marked as undiscovered on the map so it is basically impossible to distinguish the good content from the boring and repetitive gigs i did enjoy the story and quests but let just say that im big fan of the cyberpunk genre with government conspiracies high tech low life philosophy thoughtprovoking questions relating to our world and all that unfortunately this game barely touches on the tropes of cyberpunk like transhumanism its all just surface level and i get that they based it moreso on the tabletop but i wouldve loved it if they embraced the genre more the city of dreams lets move on to the gameplay and this is where the game stumbles firstly there are your roleplaying and openworld elements it your standard level up system and placing points into one of the five attributes body intelligence reflexes cool and technical ability can open up different ways to access areas dialogue options or perks cyberware is big part of this game offering up variety of modifications to each body section to suit your playstyle to name few you can equip gorilla arms or mantis blades for closequarters combat enhanced cyberdecks for those that enjoy hacking smart links to be able to curve bullets or more general enhancements that increase armour health or stamina dialogue choices may influence the story slightly discovering information in shards can open up dialogue options and such but it is not on the level of divinity original or fallout new vegas more on par with witcher 3s style the openworld elements are lacking or outright missing though some of which should be staple for any openworld game ive heard others describe night city as vast as the ocean deep as puddle and i couldnt agree more there is lot of attention to detail to make each area unique from the skyscrapers to dinky alleyways but once you start looking deeper into it the cracks become noticeable the way the ai behaves is terrible the bad wanted system minigames wheres my cybergwent and there is just lack of interactivity within the city cant sit down and eat at food vendor cant play the arcade machines cant gamble cant customise your apartment vehicles or hairstyle whoever sets up barber shop in night city would make thousands of eddies it just makes appreciate rockstar games more for the amount of effort they put into their worlds to make them come alive the combat isnt bad but it just doesnt do anything great while the weapons feel satisfying to use especially the smart weapons the combat against the braindead ai just isnt all that fun for example you can casually walk up to an enemy in cover and they do not know how to react or they rush you without any regard to their own wellbeing the stealth and hacking are fine and is good alternative for those that enjoy that style of gameplay but i honestly couldnt get into it because it was even less fun than just shooting enemies it may get better as you level up but i didnt feel the incentive to try hacking access points with breach protocol is pretty boring as well where you have to input the code in the right order deus ex human revolutionmankind divided did much better job at making hacking more engaging the driving is terrible and doesnt feel natural the cars have too much oversteer when turning and handle like boats another annoyance being that the minimap doesnt zoom out when driving so i was constantly missing turns and im big dreamer now to visuals and sound this is definitely great looking game when it is working at 100 weapon models and animations are highly detailed and flashy along with the abundance of vehicles all designed meticulously character models look fantastic with realistic looking movement and facial animations that just help to immerse into the game the issue is that bugs and glitches break that immersion constantly it is incredibly jarring to see fluid animations during conversations with main characters only to walk past dude tposing faces missing or cars stuck in the air like it is rocket league 2077 the soundtrack is awesome the guns sound impactful to shoot melee weapons have solid feel to them as well the vehicles sound great as well voice acting done by the main cast is fantastic keanu suits johnny well although i
