controversy the gamefor some people who had actively anticipated cyberpunk 2077 ever since its announcement closely watched every trailer and got themselves hyped up beyond belief the game turned out to be very disappointing luckily im convinced at least i didnt look forward to the game much at all and the only real appeal i saw was the collaboration with one of my current favorite musicians grimes who produced song for the ingame radio and voiced one of the sidequest characters other than that i really couldnt care less about this game but bought into the hype week or so prior to its release and partially transferred my wealth anyway and here we arewithout any further ado im just going to say that few games ever made so invested in them to make it little more bearable to read through ill divide my thoughts into three different paragraphsthe good 1 the designs they are absolutely stunning here from main characters to someone youll only hear few lines from throughout the game from dangerous and scary adam smasher to soothing and routine judy applies to the ingame street ads everything ever so slightly related to the samurai band later about that and clothing for the most part stellar 2 the graphics alright im guilty this very game kinda made upgrade my gpu sooner than i wanted to naturally do so its mind boggling with rtx on ive never seen any other game look prettier the sights you see while driving through the city at night are worth lot by itself 3 the characters each and every from the main character cast is very memorable and well written whenever johnny and yes the trope with the iconic character that only the protagonist can see due to said characters being inside their head is as old as the world examples arkham knight tales from the borderlands appears and starts talking about his terrorist past or just says something disturbing in general you cant help yourself but feel like hes all for real hes just that much of an idealist and you grow to love him for that at least thats the case with you either love johnny to bits or hate his guts inbetween from what ive heard but even the secondary characters like takemura and rogue are to be remembered and have countless things and unique character features to cherish them for 4 side missions just as rich if not even richer as the main story campaign while some of them are lackluster and unapologetically short quest lines such as dream on and the story of convicted murderer wanting to make difference through his newly acquired faith are going to stay with you for long long time all of the secondary quests related to samurai and silverhands past are also win the bickering between the former band members feels like those are the conflicts that couldve easily happened between any of the days of glory longtime passed rock bands be it say metallica or deep purple really authentic 5 the story yes as simple as that i really liked the main story of the game and the way it was flowing full of memorable encounters and events its the meat of the game and keeps you invested throughout written beautifully 6 the symbolism if you as silly as it sounds question yourself what makes human different from god wonder about afterlife and are curious about when does ones life truly end thats the right game to feast on the themes of faith yes faith not religion please never ever mix them together are touched very authentically in one of the sidequests too 7 audio and music the original soundtrack is perfect fit for this world from the menacing and grim v and consumer cathedral to the banging midtempo roller of the rebel path radio music is also great curated by the likes of run the jewels nina kraviz and grimes the latter contributed an absolutely stunning delicate weapon exclusively for the game too easily my favorite from all of the originals from cyberpunk 2077 the meh 1 gameplay yes as sad as it is the game gets little boring to play after while which is cardinal for game like this vehicles feel just okay the gunplay is borderline alright and the quickhack system is fun for while until you realize it was done better even in the first watch_dogs game only the story and the characters kept interested in immersing myself in more of the repetitiveness 2 customization yes sure you can customize your character to oblivion but thats about it you cant even change their haircut later on the clothing system is revolving purely around the stats and will force you to wear things you dislike for that sweetsweet combat advantage cars cant be customized whatsoever but luckily i never really cared about them in the first place but i have to admit that the game really allowed to shape and make my character exactly the way i want them to be even though if you cant be nonbinary in 2077 which i assume you cant since everyone keeps referring to you as to or she exclusively and the game doesnt really give you third option cdpr are completely missing some really important attributes of the cyberpunk genre as whole 3 cyberware oh they advertised it as the pinnacle of videogame customization but more often than not its just another way to improve your stats with visible changes only few of the implants actually change you in drastic way but what about cyberpsychosis you might ask obviously you cant go insane because of all of the chrome in your body like you can in the pennpaper rpg thatd be way too deep for triple 2020 game right 4 consequences of your actions they are kinda there some of the things you do early on really affect the story and the flow of the later side missions but is it really game changing not in slightest another overly advertised and underdelivered feature the bad 1 technical issues rtx 3060 with an i58400 are giving 5560 fps on highultra with medium rtx and dlss on what talk about optimization the amount of bugs and glitches is legendary not even worth mentioning at this point 2 expectations cdpr had it coming really never seen game advertised like that before could even order collaborative pizza from local pizzeria chain packaged in cyberpunk themed box the media the trailers the demos for the streamers its very sad you cant really see all this greatness in the game itself the expectations were set too high and we received an undercooked product as simple as that and its ones fault but cdprs conclusion so is the game really worth playing yes but not now ive had lot of fun diving deep into the games world and i have to give all of my praise to the designers writers and musicians that made it all possible for its one of my new favorite universes and i would love to play the tabletop rpg now but the amount of technical issues and broken promises is really offputting just give the developers sometime to actually fix the game might take year or even more and if you dont mind the gameplay being little underwhelming but care about the world and the characters of the game absolutely go for it now is not the time however yet im still glad i enjoyed the game seemingly lot more than some of the people i know dont have your expectation high and you will never be disappointed

game isnt perfect the number of bugs in the game currently takes you out of the immersion by making key choices seem like joke or hassle not to mention random gameplay issues that force you to reload saves just to fix quest objective then there is the poor optimisation for most older computers though what do people expect on outdated hardware due to cdpr being the developers i have doubt these mechanics my experiencealthough i would say the game was overhyped for most people it still fell well within my expectations i do agree that the number of bugs should have been flushed out before allowing you to enjoy multiple playstylesreplayabilityunlimited with different choices and different playstyles there are so many different outcomes to even the smallest of missionsmy final thoughtsif you are person that loves singleplayer storytelling and likes the freedom of choice you wont be disappointed cyberpunk 2077 throws you into one of the most beautiful cities in gaming with very few restrictions in what you can and cant do in night city offering hundreds of different choices on how to make your character what weapons you are going to use approach quests and fight enemies they all introductionelden ring is soulslike action rpg by the legendary fromsoftware the developers of the dark souls series where the main goal is to expand the genre by allowing you full access to an open world environment players will have treacherous traps to bypass devious bosses to decimate and epic distances to travel on their path to becoming an elden lord positives negatives classic souls formula where combat prowess determines your progression large selection of weapons and armour the sheer scope of the open world is overwhelming wellwritten and captivating storyline new crafting mechanic is intuitive and easytouse all damage types and builds are viable truly terrible launch where many bugs and issues still exist in the game there is tangible balance between different builds mechanically boring boss encounters an abhorrent amount of recycled content especially in the latter half of the game unannounced patchesfixes completely break builds this forces you to either farm levels to make up the gap or reassign attribute points at your own cost to fix it storyin elden ring you assume the role of warrior derogatorily known as tarnished being whose existence is an affront in this land where gold and power rule all you soon find out that this world been torn apart by countless wars and that very little of its once noble kingdoms remainyou must use sites of grace elden rings bonfire replacement to guide you across these lands and seek out the great rune bearers with the hope that you can eventually restore the elden ring itself and assume the mantle of elden lord but this is simple task as over time these great beings have become lost and confused in powerfuelled madness and they will do anything to ensure the runes remain in their graspelden rings story is mostly masked in fog and intrigue and to truly understand it in its entirety you will likely need several playthroughs and to explore every inch of its world to unravel it what is explained to you however is beautifully written and flows exceptionally well for the entirety of the gamehttpssteamcommunitycomsharedfilesfiledetailsid2790851412gameplay analysisa world where power is taken not giventhe heart of all soulslike games is inevitably the combat where prowess and skill determine whether you are victorious or suffer crushing defeat elden ring is the same for the most part combat is more forgiving than previous fromsoftware entries especially compared to their previous title sekiro where even minor mistakes could cost you dozen hours despite its fairer scenarios you will still require some finesse to progress combat is smooth and for the most part pretty fair although there are some cases where it can feel clunky or just plain brokenyou have far more freedom here to build your character exactly how you want to with limited respecs available to your character as well as plethora of weapons and armour to choose from combine all of this with both the new and improved ashes system where you can enchant nonunique weapon with specific skill and completely rebalanced magic and ranged system you have fairly dynamic gameplay experiencethere is also newly implemented crafting mechanic while i didnt use it to its full potential i can see it being useful to the player who wants an edge for boss fights or difficult encounters most crafting materials are freely available in either the openworld or as drops from specific enemieslike butter spread too thin on toastthis is the best analogy i can give to the games openworld experience in truth the scope feels extraordinary with every visible location in the distance being place worth investigating it saddens that this falls short of expectation as the games format doesnt fit this kind of experience it feels like flattened and rolledout version of the original dark souls formula without updating it all to compensate for the vast distances this is made more evident in the latter portion of the game where its riddled with recycled content bosses and enemies you have already fought will return to the fray with slightly more health or higher damage output which honestly is just lazy game design and it entirely detracts from the atmosphere intendedthere can be victory if the war was lost to begin withveterans of the genre will be glad to see the vast quantity of bosses and enemies this game to offer from monstrous dragons to overwhelming giants this game it all so it disappoints greatly to play through the entire campaign completely unimpressed by the lack of boss mechanics tactics and overall strategy there are obviously exceptions to the rule but the overall experience fighting most of them felt uninteresting and stale the side content isnt much better where you are literally just riding around looking for copypaste dungeons or crafting materials to bolster you against the next boss fightaudio and visualthere can be denying this game is stunning real treat for the eyes in nearly every aspect of its design the world is gorgeous the vistas are cinematic and the bosses are heavily detailed in way telling you story about themselves by just standing before you my only major concern is the sheer amount of golden visuals that encompass your vision matter where you look httpssteamcommunitycomsharedfilesfiledetailsid2790850758the audio falls into the same boat with most of it being recycled from previous games it immediately feels little stale there is notion of nostalgia here for sure but i think an entirely fresh experience would have done wonders to contrast this perfectly the soundtrack is just something to behold absolutely one of my favourite soundtracks ever orchestrated with each boss and zone bringing entirely new compositions to the fold and elevating the overall atmosphere pc performance and specificationswith settings set as high as they could go ive had only minor fluctuations in frame rates with my current build below game launch had an astronomical amount of issues some of which were heavily performance based most of these have since been rectified volumes of bugs and crashes experienced in under 100 hours of gameplay some texture tearing and clipping issues were presentram 32gb under load usage 39cpu i9 10900ka 370ghz under load usage 42gpu msi ventus rtx 3080 under load usage 494final thoughts very goodreview chart hereelden ring is wellwritten and gorgeous adventure that also proves without shadow of doubt that you cant simply take an existing linear formula and force it into new openworld shape without it losing some integrity vast array of new and improved mechanics as well as the large catalogue of weapons and armours you can choose from basically ensures that challenge is insurmountable and will keep you build crafting for many hours there were quite lot of bugs and performance issues at launch but these have been rectified for the most part overall decent game and one that definitely caters to larger elden ring is undoubtedly generation defining game it turns the open world meta on its head removing the pointless filler quests and npcs that make you get things for them that they really should be getting for themselves exploration is encouraged and rewarded you arent held to linear path and if you git gud you can take on end game bosses while hugely underleveledthe world is beautiful it might not have the best graphics but the art direction is incredible ive often found myself on cliff edge just looking out at the view seeing how far ive travelled and how far ive still got to gocombat is challenging but once youve learned an enemies move set and figure out how to beat it theres real sense of achievement you can beat any boss with any build so you can play the game how you want if you dont want to take the time to learn move set then cheese is usually available enemies are numerous and varied and you wont get bored fighting the same enemy over and over again even where enemies are copypaste jobs they generally have an additional attack that you werent expecting as you progress in the game which adds to the flavour common criticism is that the game story but it does it just isnt given to you you need to go looking for the story and complete side quests to understand the implications of your actions and how the characters fit together theres also lot of visual storytelling in the game and taking in the world around you helps to understand whats happening in any particular area there are couple of negatives it could do with few quality of life improvements eg more liberal use of map markers and slightly better menu navigation and sorting options there are also some small balancing issues later in the game and one particular boss with specific move that relies little too much on rng to get pastthese issues dont take away from what elden ring is its masterpiece and you should play it

style game would be enough to garner glistening recommendation from but these are among the lowest of elden rings achievements its lore is macabre and enchanting its characters memorable and haunting its soundtrack compelling and its experience incomparable it carries the spirit of true and unadulterated adventure with you thrust in the middle of familiar and alien world told only to survive and make your way to the end where you go from here is entirely your choice and the near entirety of the world is yours to explore at your own pace the sense of grandeur instilled through conventional fantasy settings like seaside castles or haunted forests is eclipsed only by the true visions of otherworldly beauty when elden ring really goes off the rails at the most unexpected of timeson more mechanical level aspects from from softwares previous games have been tweaked consolidated or removed multiplayer is far more accessible you are free to activate powerful summons in the middle of combat and recovery items will replenish by degree at times in the overworld i bristled at these changes initially seeing them as fromsoft abandoning parts of their identity to appeal to the twitter crowd but i could not have been more wrong after more than hundred hours of playtime there is not single change ive witnessed that i dont think benefits elden ring as whole in fact the game feels much more united as vision than any fromsoft game ive played in the past with each individual mechanic working in harmony with the next to further sensation of exploration consistent discovery struggle and eventual victoryits rare for game of this caliber of vision to be made and its infinitely rarer for such title to have the budget to back it up elden ring displays the potential of this medium to its fullest in an where games shift closer and closer to chores and developers concern themselves more with excising the maximum amount of money out of each individual player its not only welcome ambrosia on table of bile and muck its also singular insight into world of potent and inequitable artistry bolstered in full by just how much perseverance is required to recognize its majesty there are also incredibly hot women so i think you should get it anyway

first of all elden ring is not the best game ever made but is doesnt have to be it had slightly shaky launch was subject to reviewbombing and some day 1 issues still persist but now that the dust is settled more honest and indepth reviews are flooding in so does the dark and twisted world that made the souls games so intriguing manage to pull you in one more time do the brutal boss battles make you come back for more punishment and whats up with that best game ever stuff lets find outelden ring is very much an organic evolution of the dark souls franchise all the core mechanics are still here nothing new was introduced that i would call risky experiment on the developers side the obvious departure is the open world aspect with multiple sprawling overworld maps offering plenty of treasure and stunning vistas for you to find now if you wince at the mere mention of open world youre probably afflicted with ubisoft fatigue the feeling of emptiness after roaming humongous maps clearing nearidentical camps 50 times and collecting pointless knickknacks the good news is this is not an ubisoft title elden rings world is chockfull of secrets interesting enemies and valuable loot it isnt formulaictorrent your trusty steed that joins you early on in your adventure makes traversing the world easy and fun there is even fullyfledged mounted combat with bunch of unique animations for all weapons like in other souls titles animations are real strong point of elden ring enemies come in many different flavours from humanoid to monstrous to outright grotesque and they all have vast array of attacks thatll send you straight back to the nearest checkpoint luckily you too have ton of tools to play around with great selection of melee weapons with interchangable weapon arts special attacks that cost mana and spells of the wizardy and clericy varieties pair this with the near frameperfect hitboxes and youll be able to pull of some truly cinematic stunts at least between the bouts of anger because you rolled too lateearly againthe large world exists to reward you for exploring but youll never be required to go on lengthy journeys just for some vain completion stat fast travelling between all discovered points of interests is instant and free but should be used sparingly as there is much to simply stumble upon while youre roaming around on your horse it boggles the mind just how many nooks and crannies in some random cliff side actually have hidden cave with some unique loot in it some caves then turn out to be fullyfledged dungeons you might have entirely missed in your playthrough now obviously you could follow get op instantly guide that takes you around farming route to snatch bunch of weapons and materials but there is sense of wonder in exploring the world by yourself getting lost doesnt feel annoying and you can always just go back to an area you know betterof course the topic that makes the community erupt in furious debates over every souls title is the difficulty characteristically elden ring does not hold your hand there is quest log and all you get right off the bat are vague direction markers pointing you to the next big thing if youre ready for that big thing is another story entirely as the game is meant to be played at pace you choose for yourself you never must clear out camp or beat roaming world boss if youre having trouble with specific enemy leave and come back when youre stronger as with souls dying is meant to be learning experience now you know that the big windup attack actually tracks you and goes super far now you know you need to roll bit later to actually dodge the delayed thrust now you know you should kill the trumpet guy first or hell alert the whole camp luckily every somewhat difficult fight special resurrection shrine nearby that lets you get right back into the action albeit with all enemies respawningif i had to criticise the game itd be the sometimes confusing controls and the clunky menues that have always been thing in souls games the story is alright but is really just means to get you from boss fight to boss fight quests are very minor side thought and thats fine because the fights are the main selling points here and they are spectacular one last point on the topic of pvp invasions by other players are disabled by default while youre playing on your own its now true singleplayer experience unless you opt into pvp or coop keep in mind that whilst other players friendly or not are present in your world the horse is disabledso to come back to the opener elden ring isnt the best game ever but it is pretty damn good souls veterans will enjoy the evolution of their beloved franchise whilst new players will have more accessible world to peruse without getting too frustrated about being stuck anywhere in particular if elden ring is the first ever souls game you play you will still have good time as long as you can maintain growth mindset and thrive in overcoming difficulty through practise and perseverance

good morning night citynight city 2077 you play as v mercenary that wants to be legend in night city and for this to happen youll need to steal the relic biochip invented by arasaka one of the most influential megacorporations in the whole world now that ive just scratched the surface of the plot i can begin with this review city of dreamscyberpunk 2077 the most beautiful city that ive ever seen in video game and at first sight the most vivid city in game history but only at first sight when walking through night city you can see all npcs going on with their lives working shopping or just walking around but of course like in any game it is just an illusion to make the city feel alive however they failed trying to build up this illusion mainly when there is major interaction with the npcs just oneline dialog that repeats over and over again just like in the witcher 3 but here in cyberpunk hits different another thing that killed that illusion for personally was the crowd ai oh boy that ai is terrible when you look back at gta v and older games even and compare its ai with cyberpunk well there is comparison cyberpunk 2077 ai in general are awful and totally immersion breaker and for sure they were big dreamerscontinuing on with the world itself cdpr managed to handcraft beautiful and immersive openworld full of details that you can get lost in its beauty although there isnt lot to do in it in my point of view night city as i said is the most beautiful but at the same time the most empty city that ive seen in the past years because there is absolutely nothing to do in this huge city besides walking and doing some repetitive activities that pop up around the map yet there are random events like weve seen in red dead redemption 2 for example nor extracurricular activities as we see in many other games hell even in gta san andreas 2004 we could go to the gym barbershops casinos even take taxi so on another one of its downsides is the lack of character customization after the character creation for game where style is everything this is huge problem im pretty sure that cdpr planned lot of those activities but to meet the deadlines theyve had to cut it out of the final game now we just need to wait and see if theyre going to implement some of those things in the gameback in 2019 cdpr stated that cyberpunk would have wanted system and corrupt police well at least we got wanted system but not as you expected the police system is just awful literally there is car chase or proper ai for the police they just spawn behind you whatever the place you are at i remember gta 3 from 2001 having better police ai than cyberpunk and thats ridiculousthis is rpg after allat the end of the day cyberpunk 2077 tries to be an rpg but is it really when they first announced the lifepaths i got really excited and even more when i read that every lifepath choice would affect the world around you and that was big fat lie first of all lifepaths just change the game introduction and some minor dialog options and thats it major changes at all about the general choices yes lot of the choices that you made in the main quests or even side quests can have an impact on your ending or at least some important dialogs throughout the story when it comes to rpgs one of the most important things is the skill tree here in cyberpunk we have huge skill tree and it works quite similar to the skyrim skill tree you can upgrade your character to be melee specialist heavy weapon specialist or combine everything in one and be an overpowered one tap machinethe gameplay itself is pretty average nothing spectacular but not bad either we can carry 3 main weapons and toss variety of grenades there are the implants that we can only buy new ones or change the currently equipped on ripper docs the implants that you acquire on ripper docs can play huge role in your gameplay as you can upgrade your max health and carry weight etcthe hidden gem not so hiddenthe best part of the game so far is the main story and the main side quests if i can put it that way cdpr did great job telling the story in way that you dont feel overwhelmed or tired and gets even better when you get to know the characters and their stories you can connect really easily with the characters and thats huge point for in this huge game industry lately theres been lack of good characters that you feel for and cyberpunk 2077 makes you care about the characters even more than you shouldthe soundtrack is impressive even if many of the songs didnt suit my style they did awesome work creating the soundtrack unfortunately the main quests are too short compared to witcher 3 about 20 hours if you rush throughout the game i finished the main plot in 50 hours however half of my playtime was doing side missions and exploring the map ive had so much fun doing side missions and some ofem are i dare say better than some of the main storyrelated quests the not so good the bad and the uglynonetheless the bugs as everyone might know by now cyberpunk 2077 is full of bugs i can make book with five thousand pages about the bugs in my playthrough i didnt encounter any gamebreaking bug thank god but theres lot of glitches for example cars flying around npcs appearing from nowhere and lot of clipping glitches more than usual etc the most annoying bugs are questrelated ones even though i didnt encounter any gamebreaking bugs there are still some glitches that ruined my immersion and i hope that theyll fix those very soonconclusionim really divided about this game in one hand there are the great main storyside quests and the great characters but on the other hand theres lot of bugs glitches and main issues that make this impressive world well less impressive ill recommend cyberpunk 2077 more because of its great story characters and fun gameplay however we should treat this review as mixed one but steam doesnt allow us to do so im looking forward to seeing if cdpr will pull off hello games and make cyberpunk more enjoyable game

this was probably my first preorder i felt that if the game turned out to be the worst game i played or didnt even run 10 dollars i paid for the witcher 2 and the witcher 3 felt so much like stealing that the extra 60 would still not cover the amount i would pay for the enjoyment i got from themafter putting 160 hours on cyberpunk 2077 i can say that it fully deserves the full price i paid for it on its own merits and after so many disappointments in the recent aaa releases that i had this is the highest praise that i can give to this game ill start by saying that i love urban spaces i love finding alleyways that i have never seen before in my real life neighbourhood i love seeing all those lit up windows at night and i love that there are so many details and slices of life in every corner in city city to is the greatest work the humanity can achieve due to its intricacy its organic nature and how it reflects the human condition since the liberty city of gta iv most games have been disappointment in this regard for example skyrims cities consisted of 20 npcs and copy pasted guards santos of gta v was just sanitary and small theme park that just could not function as city if it was translated into real life and san francisco of watch_dogs 2 was utterly devoid of character and charm previous game of cd projekt red the witcher 3 came close to what i expect from digital urban space novigrad and to some extent toussaint were brimming with life and had all the details that real urban space might have but failed in sizethe real protagonist of the marketing campaign for this game was the city itself especially in night city wire episodes v and his or her story was in the background and rightly so because this game even with its minor issues been the greatest city that ever been built in game every district even every alleyway so many details that i was amazed that my gtx 1070 could even run it at stable fps rate too by the way there is never seen before verticality in night city when gta iv came out i was impressed how many buildings there were that you could enter but most of them were just copy paste jobs with real character to them in 12 years that passed since its release i had expected that this would be polished and taken further but this did not happen until now night city on the other hand does not only offer tons of welldesigned buildings that you can enter but completely opens up new appreciation for the city once you get the leg cyberware that allows you to double or power jump you probably should get one of those early you can probably spend hours parkouring around buildings while focusing on every little detail that been lovingly crafted and placed even some streets have multiple levels and while this is common occurrence in real cities i never noticed their absence in digital urban spaces until i visited night city not only verticality distinguishes night city from others at 160 hours i know that there are probably hundreds of alleyways and tens of shopsbarsbuildings that i never visited and even though i have completed the game at this point i look forward to going back to the game and dissect every little detail in those and the small stories they tell especially whoever designed the graffiti around the city deserves raise as i often found myself looking at those admiringly wishing that the city i live in had some of thosegameplay wise i was not expecting much just witcher in 2077 and this would have satisfied but the game we got is beautiful lovechild of the witcher and deus ex every minor quest offers multiple paths you can take if you have the necessary skill level on body or technical ability and i had fun exploring every one of them that i could have found but i can not deny that this level of freedom sometimes makes the game too easy and if you can not go through some path you can always find alternatives that allows you to skip most of the level and reach the objective quicklygames difficulty level i played on hard is not helped by the fact that there are so many perks you can obtain to transform yourself into demigod that one shots the opponent most of the time i was doing 400k damage with my sniper rifle at the end of the game but enemies can often one shot you as well if you are playing on hard or very hard if you are an experienced player i absolutely recommend picking one of those two difficulty levels there is good amount of weapon variety and unique reload and equip animations and they make you feel like the most badass merc in the city you can also use different hacks to keep your hands relatively clean but i wont spoil this part as i loved seeing how those most of those hacks worked for the first timestory and the characters are amazing i did not think that i would enjoy this game as much as i did enjoy the witcher games as i am annoyed by the rampant individualism of the modern world and most of the themes of the cyberpunk genre hit too close to home but they found good balance between the dissolving sense of community and aforementioned rampant individualism i did not expect that the so many of the character side quests would dabble on the same issue that been driving mad and this theme was executed perfectly without stepping on too many tropes of the modern storywriting for these side quests i feel that the only thing is missing is proper closure or change that impact the world but it is also possible to consider this as deliberate choice as v is just passing merc and not the main character one of the most groundbreaking parts of cyberpunk 2077 is that usually you feel like companion in other peoples main quests and this is extremely refreshing to see game where the world does not revolve around player character i feel like this should have been fleshed out more with stalker like system where every gangcommunity its explicit objectives and the player can see and impact this dynamic struggle for power or survival but maybe this is expecting too much from game that already achieves so muchthe main story is more related to traditional cyberpunk genre themes especially transhumanism libertarian erosion of the state or in better terms absolute corporate dictatorship and artificial intelligence but how they are presented elevates cyberpunk 2077 from another example of the genre to unique experience compared to newer deus ex games where these themes are so on the nose that these issues become mundane everyday thing cyberpunk 2077 with the inclusion of johnny silverhand approaches these themes with so much clarity and simplicity that you never feel the necessity to take breather to adjust your suspension of disbelief you may feel like the main story should have been longer and i thought of the same from time to time but at least there is cohesive story that will force an expulsion of feelings catharsis at numerous points of the story first person point of view and plethora of facial expressions that the characters employ greatly contributes to this as v been much more of relatable character than the most due to povanother innovation that i believe will pass under the radar is how i never felt the obligation to be mr goody two shoes during the game and could usually transfer my personal beliefs and judgement into the story without being punished by it which is so rare in most games you will often be punished by locking you out of content or forcing you to get worse ending if you are not some form of stoic angel but cyberpunk 2077 does not have this problemplease see comments for the rest of my review as i have exhausted the space given to by steam sounds bugs and final conclusion are in the comments

introductionelden ring is soulslike action rpg by the legendary fromsoftware the developers of the dark souls series where the main goal is to expand the genre by allowing you full access to an open world environment players will have treacherous traps to bypass devious bosses to decimate and epic distances to travel on their path to becoming an elden lord positives negatives classic souls formula where combat prowess determines your progression large selection of weapons and armour the sheer scope of the open world is overwhelming wellwritten and captivating storyline new crafting mechanic is intuitive and easytouse all damage types and builds are viable truly terrible launch where many bugs and issues still exist in the game there is tangible balance between different builds mechanically boring boss encounters an abhorrent amount of recycled content especially in the latter half of the game unannounced patchesfixes completely break builds this forces you to either farm levels to make up the gap or reassign attribute points at your own cost to fix it storyin elden ring you assume the role of warrior derogatorily known as tarnished being whose existence is an affront in this land where gold and power rule all you soon find out that this world been torn apart by countless wars and that very little of its once noble kingdoms remainyou must use sites of grace elden rings bonfire replacement to guide you across these lands and seek out the great rune bearers with the hope that you can eventually restore the elden ring itself and assume the mantle of elden lord but this is simple task as over time these great beings have become lost and confused in powerfuelled madness and they will do anything to ensure the runes remain in their graspelden rings story is mostly masked in fog and intrigue and to truly understand it in its entirety you will likely need several playthroughs and to explore every inch of its world to unravel it what is explained to you however is beautifully written and flows exceptionally well for the entirety of the gamehttpssteamcommunitycomsharedfilesfiledetailsid2790851412gameplay analysisa world where power is taken not giventhe heart of all soulslike games is inevitably the combat where prowess and skill determine whether you are victorious or suffer crushing defeat elden ring is the same for the most part combat is more forgiving than previous fromsoftware entries especially compared to their previous title sekiro where even minor mistakes could cost you dozen hours despite its fairer scenarios you will still require some finesse to progress combat is smooth and for the most part pretty fair although there are some cases where it can feel clunky or just plain brokenyou have far more freedom here to build your character exactly how you want to with limited respecs available to your character as well as plethora of weapons and armour to choose from combine all of this with both the new and improved ashes system where you can enchant nonunique weapon with specific skill and completely rebalanced magic and ranged system you have fairly dynamic gameplay experiencethere is also newly implemented crafting mechanic while i didnt use it to its full potential i can see it being useful to the player who wants an edge for boss fights or difficult encounters most crafting materials are freely available in either the openworld or as drops from specific enemieslike butter spread too thin on toastthis is the best analogy i can give to the games openworld experience in truth the scope feels extraordinary with every visible location in the distance being place worth investigating it saddens that this falls short of expectation as the games format doesnt fit this kind of experience it feels like flattened and rolledout version of the original dark souls formula without updating it all to compensate for the vast distances this is made more evident in the latter portion of the game where its riddled with recycled content bosses and enemies you have already fought will return to the fray with slightly more health or higher damage output which honestly is just lazy game design and it entirely detracts from the atmosphere intendedthere can be victory if the war was lost to begin withveterans of the genre will be glad to see the vast quantity of bosses and enemies this game to offer from monstrous dragons to overwhelming giants this game it all so it disappoints greatly to play through the entire campaign completely unimpressed by the lack of boss mechanics tactics and overall strategy there are obviously exceptions to the rule but the overall experience fighting most of them felt uninteresting and stale the side content isnt much better where you are literally just riding around looking for copypaste dungeons or crafting materials to bolster you against the next boss fightaudio and visualthere can be denying this game is stunning real treat for the eyes in nearly every aspect of its design the world is gorgeous the vistas are cinematic and the bosses are heavily detailed in way telling you story about themselves by just standing before you my only major concern is the sheer amount of golden visuals that encompass your vision matter where you look httpssteamcommunitycomsharedfilesfiledetailsid2790850758the audio falls into the same boat with most of it being recycled from previous games it immediately feels little stale there is notion of nostalgia here for sure but i think an entirely fresh experience would have done wonders to contrast this perfectly the soundtrack is just something to behold absolutely one of my favourite soundtracks ever orchestrated with each boss and zone bringing entirely new compositions to the fold and elevating the overall atmosphere pc performance and specificationswith settings set as high as they could go ive had only minor fluctuations in frame rates with my current build below game launch had an astronomical amount of issues some of which were heavily performance based most of these have since been rectified volumes of bugs and crashes experienced in under 100 hours of gameplay some texture tearing and clipping issues were presentram 32gb under load usage 39cpu i9 10900ka 370ghz under load usage 42gpu msi ventus rtx 3080 under load usage 494final thoughts very goodreview chart hereelden ring is wellwritten and gorgeous adventure that also proves without shadow of doubt that you cant simply take an existing linear formula and force it into new openworld shape without it losing some integrity vast array of new and improved mechanics as well as the large catalogue of weapons and armours you can choose from basically ensures that challenge is insurmountable and will keep you build crafting for many hours there were quite lot of bugs and performance issues at launch but these have been rectified for the most part overall decent game and one that definitely caters to larger audience than ever before i can recommend this game in its current state but if you havent been fan of the genre in the past perhaps wait for salefollow our curator page summit reviews to see more after one year following its release i feel i can finally review this troubled yet addictive game it shouldve been amazing but it ended up being just alright as an rpg it doesnt deliver as everyone hoped you can still be immersed in the game but eventually youll run into something that reminds you that youre not really in control of who you are v is really cool character but other than subtle things like the look of their genitals which is funny considering it affects absolutely nothing v isnt character that you can truly call your own i havent played as female v nor any other class besides streetkid but it seems like once you choose class thats where your ability to really customize your character ends there are many things i do like about cyberpunk 2077 which is why i gave it positive review night city itself is gorgeous driving around and looking at all the details and colors is really breathtaking you know however besides that its dead the npcs act dumb they say the same things and theyll sometimes replicate to the point where ill turn corner and see 10 exact same npcs just walking together to distract myself from how immersivebreaking this is ill joke around and say its just glitch in the matrix pun intended now for the man of the hour johnny silverhand in my opinion his character and the relationship with v is the strongest part of the game his remarks during missions makes for fun time and always helped feed that immersive desire that i so desperately wanted other characters such as panam judy and river help the game feel more immersive but it falls flat once youre done with their missions its like they ghost v after while in the end v really only their cyberware cars and apartment the cyberware gameplay is pretty fun and getting upgrades is exciting as for cars there are 26 cars you can purchase but theres not really reason to buy cars when you can just hijack them for free although you cant keep them on top of that you cant store your owned cars in nice garage or anything its very disappointing that you can not change single thing about vs apartment or even buy different one ultimately the narrative is driven by forced events that detract from the rpg element we all hoped for v story to tell but youll find that your choices dont affect it as much as they should if you forget about the letdown regarding the rpg element i think cyberpunk 2077 is solid game the story is fascinating the dialogue is entertaining and the characters are interesting cdpr included bunch of lore within this game and exploring that lore is worth it its just sad to think how much better it couldve been it feels like we got small piece of the final product however by now i think most people have come to accept this game for what it is now that it goes on sale for 30 id recommend picking it up and giving it try if you can get past the failed ambitions i believe theres plenty of enjoyment to be found

skyrim special edition is the remaster of skyrim the latest in bethesdas elder scrolls series this version adds remastered graphics effects and lighting however it means that youll need higher specs to play and sometimes the game stutters for reason it also includes all dlcs you play as the dragonborn chosen individual who is prophesied to defeat the evil dragon alduin skyrim is an openworld rpg with many similar gameplay mechanics to the fallout games but both games have its own unique featuresother than the main quest there are also 5 factions you could join each with their own unique main quests and side quests none of the factions storyline conflict with each other so you can do all of them in one playthrough there are the companions thieves guild college of winterhold dark brotherhood and civil war where you must choose between imperials or stormcloaks although theyre optional you should finish them as their stories are quite interesting and offer new followers and unique gearas i mentioned above skyrim special edition already included the 3 dlcs dawnguard hearthfire and dragonborn since they have separate pages ill review the dlcs heredawnguard is story dlc that adds new areas in the main map in this dlc you can join the dawnguard group of vampire hunters or be vampire yourself and join the volkihar clan the option to choose side comes early in the dlc and you can not change sides once youve chosen after that there are some unique quests for both factions but most of them are similar your vampire companion will stay with you matter which side you choosehearthfire is different than the other 2 dlcs since it doesnt add new questline but allows you to build house from zero in dawnstar falkreath and morthal after helping the jarls from each area you will have to gather materials for your house this dlc also allows you to adopt children dragonborn is the last story dlc and takes you to whole new area solstheim here you must find and defeat miraak the first dragonborn the environment of solstheim is very different from skyrim and there are new enemies and gear as well you can bring companions in and out of solstheim but not your horse therefore it is recommended to find arvak in dawnguards storyline since this horse can be summoned thereupdate because of skyrims 10th anniversary skyrim received some new content available for free the most important being 2 new questlines you will get the saints and seducers questline revolving around daedras of the same name from shivering isles and fishing questline where you collect fishes and do some bounties for cool rewards you can also build aquariums in your hearthfire homes cellar the other 2 new additions are hardcore survival mode and the addition of some new items like weapons outfits etcif you do buy the anniversary edition upgrade you will receive even more new content previously from creation club and some new ones however sadly the cc content isnt voiced characters just say generic lines and talk through the notes they give you most of them are callbacks to previous tes games like the saints and seducers so if you like the older tes games it might be worth considering

the sky above the portwas the colour of televisiontuned to dead channel neuromancerwhere does cyberpunk 2077 stand in its genre id say its just as impactful as the first deus ex and its as raw and haunting as it gets in terms of experience and this is whymost of the current reviews deal with performance optimization bugs or graphics these issues are mostly addressable and theyre likely going to be fixed this review wont cover thatseen plenty of people complain about the style over substance topic and this is the thing that i want to discuss and argue against its easy to miss lot of the worldbuilding and the homage it pays to the classics of the cyberpunk genre the plot itself the mind construct part was something talked about in the 1995 ghost in the shell the voodoo boys are the best netrunners and they are possibly inspired by count zero by william gibson close inspection of certain wall will reveal tribute paid to roy betty and blade runnermost importantly some of the topics that can be read about are scary glimpses of our future deforestation turning the amazonian rainforests into the amazonian plains the corporations gathering so much power that they end up competing economically and militarily with governments to the point that conflicts between corporations turn to full scale wars poverty and famine forcing people into migration and leading to terrorism and gang wars becoming so common that weapons are sold as easily as candy the autonomy and death of the net defeated people with little future ahead of them succumbing to hedonism drugs and sex are easily purchased and even encouraged in order to keep the mind busy cyberpunk 2077 captures the over the top flashy soulless world perfectly so well that it might even seem just that and trick the players themselves style over substance experience is what you get if one does rush through quests and the fighting without paying attention to what is readable and the surroundings cyberpunk 2077 is gritty brutal dystopia where hedonism and corporatocracy won and its potentially where were heading as well for better or worsei do recommend it for the world building and the issues that it touches they may not be obvious at first but they are there the rest of the stuff about technical details and gameplay theyve been talked about already in most reviews just dont treat the game like gta or fallout its closer to deus ex in how its both played out and the questions it tries to raiseill likely play it twice theres huge amount of content the characters are brilliant and while its all confusing and raw at first it does make sense slowly and its quite typical for the cyberpunk style to present itself like that fair warning that if youre new to the genre the game wont take you easy on terminology luckily there is database that makes that more tolerable ingame

put in effort to master game i like to do it by planning my moves ahead of time and experimenting with the tools im given not by mastering each inthemoment microtwitch movement if youre like and the button and when your character even starts to move in the middle of this games tightly timed fights thats huge it took hours upon hours of wondering why dodging felt so bad before i realized what unique key why can we only use the special effect on our righthand when we can just briefly unequip it to use our lefthand weapon why do equippedbutunused weapons add to your carry weight if youre as i feel i hover around good chunk of elden ring having been done i believe im in much better position to offer my thoughts on it ill begin with summationelden ring is one of those onceinalifetime experiences and deserves to be played by anyone with the grit to see it througha world of uniformly aweinspiring beauty paired with what is easily the most multifaceted combat system of any soulsesque style game would be enough to garner glistening recommendation from but these are among the lowest of elden rings achievements its lore is macabre and enchanting its characters memorable and haunting its soundtrack compelling and its experience incomparable it carries the spirit of true and unadulterated adventure with you thrust in the middle of familiar and alien world told only to survive and make your way to the end where you go from here is entirely your choice and the near entirety of the world is yours to explore at your own pace the sense of grandeur instilled through conventional fantasy settings like seaside castles or haunted forests is eclipsed only by the true visions of otherworldly beauty when elden ring really goes off the rails at the most unexpected of timeson more mechanical level aspects from from softwares previous games have been tweaked consolidated or removed multiplayer is far more accessible you are free to activate powerful summons in the middle of combat and recovery items will replenish by degree at times in the overworld i bristled at these changes initially seeing them as fromsoft abandoning parts of their identity to appeal to the twitter crowd but i could not have been more wrong after more than hundred hours of playtime there is not single change ive witnessed that i dont think benefits elden ring as whole in fact the game feels much more united as vision than any fromsoft game ive played in the past with each individual mechanic working in harmony with the next to further sensation of exploration consistent discovery struggle and eventual victoryits rare for game of this caliber of vision to be made and its infinitely rarer for such title to have the budget to back it up elden ring displays the potential of this medium to its fullest in an where games shift closer and closer to chores and developers concern themselves more with excising the maximum amount of money out of each individual player its not only welcome ambrosia on table of bile and muck its also singular insight into world of potent and inequitable artistry bolstered in full by just how much perseverance is required to recognize its majesty there are also incredibly hot women so i think you should get it anyway
